Upgrade your units to detect them!|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 9 (Formerly, [[Headache Headquarters]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Ninja Toilet''' was a hidden enemy that appeared in [[Headache Headquarters]], replacing the [[Hidden]]. Currently, it only appears when the [[Brain Rot]] modifier is activated in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, replacing every [[Hidden]] modern variant, or with its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]. It has a high amount of health and was faster than the [[Toilet]]. Additionally, it is a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemy, meaning that only towers with hidden detection could detect it. ==Appearance== The '''Ninja Toilet''' was a white toilet with two plungers on the back. It had a pale skinned head coming out of it, which used the {{RLinkC|86487700|Man Face}} and had a white headband. ==Headache Headquarters Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Headache Headquarters]] is listed instead. *Strong early-game towers like the [[Militant]], [[Golden Scout]] or [[Golden Cowboy]] are very effective here. **Stalling towers, like the [[Freezer]] or [[Electroshocker]], can also be useful, due to the '''Ninja Toilet's''' speed. *High DPS towers like the [[Minigunner]] and [[Accelerator]] can be useful against this. *The [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can be useful at boosting the firerate and range of your towers respectively. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1NinjaToilet.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseNinjaToilet.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} NinjaToiletIconIG.png|'''Ninja Toilet''' on its [[Index]] icon. ManFace.png|'''Ninja Toilet's''' face. }} ==Trivia== *The plungers on the back of this enemy are the {{RLinkC|417456986|Plunger Swordpack}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. *The '''Ninja Toilet''' enemy was inspired by the ''Skibidi Toilet'' series, with it being based on the [[w:c:skibidi-toilet:Normal Skibidi Toilet|Normal Skibidi Toilet]]. **Plungers are a weapon commonly used in ''Skibidi Toilet''. ==Update History== *'''1 April 2024''' - [[v1.17.2]] **'''Ninja Toilet''' added. *'''8 April 2024''' - [[v1.18.0]]b **'''Ninja Toilet''' removed. *'''16 December 2024''' - [[v1.46.0]] **'''Ninja Toilet''' re-added, exclusively to [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. **{{Bug}} Has no neck in the [[Index]]. *'''1 April 2025''' - [[v1.58.0|v1.58.1a]] **'''Ninja Toilet''' now appears in [[Headache Headquarters]] as part of [[April Fools 2025 Event]]. *'''8 April 2025''' - [[v1.59.0|v1.59.6b]] **'''Ninja Toilet''' no longer appears in [[Headache Headquarters]], now only appears in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''8 April 2026''' - [[v1.86.0|v1.86.5a]] **'''Ninja Toilet''' now appears in [[Headache Headquarters]] as part of [[Aprilini Foolsini Eventini]]. *'''8 April 2026''' - [[v1.88.0|v1.88.2a]] **'''Ninja Toilet''' no longer appears in [[Headache Headquarters]], now only appears in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. {{HeadacheHQ|[[Metal Toilet]]|Wave 6|Ninja Toilet|Wave 8|[[Png Bot2]]|Wave 10}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
